new_support: NES SMB1-family NROM32 music-only playback;49 registered whole32KiB PRG fingerprints,14 area/event queue commands each

discovery.method: Exact common sound-block hashes selected candidates only. Acceptance uses whole PRG size/CRC, not short patterns/filename/sound region alone. A region-only control-flow analysis attempt was not complete and is not used.

implementation.adapter: Own in-memory NSF header/6502 startup shim executes original SoundEngine using existing static GME
implementation.memory: Only private startup shim/queue tables in first256PRG bytes; original music code/data preserved. CHR graphics not used. Original file/trainer/save not written; no reset/NMI/PPU/game boot. No extracted NSF saved by application.
implementation.selection: Area masks01/02/04/08/10/20/40 and corresponding event masks,14 entries including aliases/jingles. Stop80 excluded. No claim of14 unique compositions.
implementation.channels: Four base NES lanes always visible; first two area entries retain original4011 DAC in DMC lane, not a DPCM sample extraction claim. Mask is known before playback and stable per selection.
implementation.cadence: Registered NTSC/PAL reference-family speed16639/19997us. Full game transient/context/alternate-region behavior is not reproduced.
implementation.seek: Short positions up to1000ms replay exact state; longer positions use unchanged GME fast seek to target-1000ms and render up to1000ms warmup. Existing NSF/GBA backends unchanged.
implementation.association: New .nes option,22 extension registration plan; OS defaults not forced

validation.own_fixtures: Independent6502 APU generator observes both queues; invalid/truncated/header/mapper/trainer/NES2/unknown program reject, source/image preservation and PAL fields pass

actual_programs.checks: Finite positive output, stable usage masks, deterministic replay, exact500ms seek(delta0), all-voice mute, graphics-only mutation identical output, driver mutation rejected, original file readback unchanged
actual_programs.scope: Beginnings only; not full-song physical listening

long_seek.checks: Original looping driver remains audible, rewind succeeds

validation.screenshot: Own recording view visually inspected: Underground, four base lanes and nonflat original APU signals. Ran before final seek/error-text refinement; those changes do not alter layout/navigation.
validation.failure_fixed: First new adapter delegated seek directly to existing GME, which did not preserve sample-identical filter history. ROM-only bounded replay/warmup added; original NSF code untouched. Initial failure log retained privately.
validation.baseline: User-confirmed existing features reused; no full baseline suite or packaged GUI rerun. Targeted new NES/registration checks only.
validation.audio: Offline/dummy, own test process only; no hardware listening
